description: Documentation coverage checks for OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS) and OWASP Top 10. Checks whether security requirements are identified and described in the project artifacts.

rules.title: Authentication Requirements
rules.description: Authentication mechanisms must be documented and secured.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for authentication requirements, MFA, password policies, or session handling.
rules.recommendation: Document authentication requirements including password policies, MFA, and session handling.

rules.title: Authorization & Access Control
rules.description: Authorization model and role-based access must be defined.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for authorization model, RBAC, permission definitions, or access control rules.
rules.recommendation: Define authorization model, user roles, and access control rules.

rules.title: Input Validation
rules.description: All user input must be validated and sanitized.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for input validation strategy, sanitization, XSS prevention, or injection prevention.
rules.recommendation: Document input validation strategy including server-side validation, sanitization, and injection prevention.

rules.title: Security Audit Logging
rules.description: Security-relevant events must be logged for audit and incident response.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for audit logging requirements, security event logging, or monitoring specifications.
rules.recommendation: Specify what security events must be logged, retention period, and alerting rules.

rules.title: Secure Error Handling
rules.description: Error responses must not expose sensitive internal details.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for secure error handling requirements or restrictions on error information disclosure.
rules.recommendation: Document secure error handling to prevent leaking sensitive stack traces or system information.

rules.title: Session & Token Management
rules.description: Session lifecycle and token security must be defined.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for session lifecycle, token expiration, CSRF protection, or cookie security requirements.
rules.recommendation: Define session lifecycle, token expiration, CSRF protection, and secure cookie requirements.

rules.title: Security Testing Requirements
rules.description: Security testing must be part of the quality process.
rules.evidenceHint: Look for penetration testing scope, vulnerability scanning tools, or security acceptance criteria.
rules.recommendation: Include security testing requirements such as penetration testing scope, tools, and acceptance criteria.
